lines.en: label day77:
scene amimak1
: ...and that’s how you find slope-intercept form. Any questions?
lines.zh: : ……这就是求斜截式的方法。有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Umm...could you please repeat...all of that?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你能不能把……全部重复一遍？

lines.en: scene amimak2
: Sensei, I have no idea what else I’m supposed to do. She’s just not retaining any information.
lines.zh: : 老师，我真不知道我还能怎么办。她根本记不住任何信息。

lines.en: scene amimak3
: That’s just because you keep using big words and weird terms like ‘slope intercept form.’ Who the heck even knows what that is?!
lines.zh: : 那只是因为你老是用些大词和奇怪的术语，什么「斜截式」。谁他妈知道那是什么东西啊？！

lines.en: scene amimak4
: Everyone! Or at least we’re supposed to!
lines.zh: : 所有人都知道！至少我们本来就该知道！

lines.en: mak "The next mandatory test is based almost entirely around this and, if you can’t even remember what it’s
lines.zh: mak 「下一次的统考几乎全考这个，如果你连它

lines.en: called, there is no way you’re going to pass."
lines.zh: 叫什么都记不住，那你绝对不可能及格。」

lines.en: scene amimak5
: Ahhhh! Why can’t all of our tests just be about how to be a good caretaker?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！为什么我们的考试不能全考怎么当个好管家？！

lines.en: : If you can’t even figure out slope intercept form, there’s no way you’re a good caretaker.
lines.zh: : 如果你连斜截式都搞不懂，你就不可能是个好管家。

lines.en: scene amimak4
: Those two things have absolutely nothing in common!
lines.zh: : 这两件事八竿子打不着！

lines.en: : And besides, I’m a much better caretaker than you’ll ever be, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 再说了，我当管家可比你强多了，Makoto！

lines.en: : Take that back!
lines.zh: : 把那句话收回去！

lines.en: : No!
: Yes!
lines.zh: : 收回！

lines.en: : No!
So-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: I bet you’re probably wondering how I ended up in this position.
lines.zh: 我猜你大概在想，我是怎么落到这个处境的。

lines.en: And, to be honest, I am too.
lines.zh: 而说实话，我也在想。

lines.en: It all started with Ami coming up to me in class and asking for help with algebra.
lines.zh: 一切始于 Ami 在课上跑来找我，问我能不能帮她学代数。

lines.en: "I guess a boring thing like that must have caused Makoto’s geek-radar
lines.zh: 「我猜这种无聊的东西一定触发了 Makoto 的

lines.en: to go off because she immediately jumped up and volunteered to help coach Ami on the subject."
lines.zh: 书呆子雷达，因为她立刻跳起来主动要帮 Ami 补这门课。」

lines.en: Of course, Ami wanted me around as well, so...
lines.zh: 当然，Ami 也想让我在场，所以……

lines.en: Here we are. ‘Learning’ things.
lines.zh: 我们就在这儿。「学习」东西。

lines.en: : You two really don’t get along, do you?
lines.zh: : 你们两个真的合不来，是吧？

lines.en: scene amimak6
: Makoto is just jealous because you spend more time with me than her.
lines.zh: : Makoto 只是嫉妒而已，因为你跟我在一起的时间比跟她多。

lines.en: scene amimak7
: I-I am not! I’m just trying to help you so you don’t get held back!
lines.zh: : 我、我才没有！我只是想帮你，免得你留级！

lines.en: : See? She’s yelling at me to try and impress you but you’re not impressed at all, are you Sensei?
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？她冲我大吼大叫，想给你留下好印象，可你一点印象都没有，对吧老师？

lines.en: : I’m...wait...what’s going on, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我……等等……到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene amimak8
: Sensei! Tell her to focus or she’s never going to get into a good[school] and become a doctor.
lines.zh: : 老师！叫她专心点，不然她永远进不了好[school]，也当不上医生。

lines.en: scene amimak9
: I don’t wanna be a doctor! I wanna be a housewife!
lines.zh: : 我才不想当医生！我想当家庭主妇！

lines.en: scene amimak10
: Who in their right mind would marry someone who doesn’t even know slope intercept form?!
lines.zh: : 哪个脑子正常的人会娶一个连斜截式都不知道的人？！

lines.en: : None of your business!
lines.zh: : 关你屁事！

lines.en: : I bet Sensei doesn’t even know the formula for that!
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌老师连那个公式都不知道！

lines.en: Please don’t drag me into this.
lines.zh: 求你别把我扯进去。

lines.en: : Preposterous! Of course he does!
lines.zh: : 荒谬！他当然知道！

lines.en: : No way! He doesn’t like boring stuff like that!
lines.zh: : 才不可能！他不喜欢那种无聊的东西！

lines.en: : It’s not boring just because it’s educational!
lines.zh: : 有教育意义不代表无聊！

lines.en: scene amimak11
: Sensei! What is the formula for slope intercept form?!
lines.zh: : 老师！斜截式的公式是什么？！

lines.en: : Uhh...
menu:
m = bx + y
lines.zh: m = bx + y

lines.en: : Definitely ‘m = bx + y.’
lines.zh: : 肯定是「m = bx + y」。

lines.en: scene amimak12
: Tch-!
: Teehee~ Told you he doesn’t know!
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻~我就说他不知道！

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t interested in that kind of stuff!
lines.zh: : 老师对那种东西没兴趣！

lines.en: : That’s simply not true! Of course he’s interested in that kind of stuff. He just had...a momentary memory lapse.
lines.zh: : 那绝对不是真的！他当然对那种东西感兴趣。他只是……短暂地失忆了一下。

lines.en: : Things like that happen.
lines.zh: : 这种事常有。

lines.en: : Whatever you say, Makoto~
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说啦，Makoto~

lines.en: y = mx + b
lines.zh: y = mx + b

lines.en: : Easy. ‘y = mx + b.’
lines.zh: : 简单。「y = mx + b」。

lines.en: scene amimak13
: Ah-!
: I expected nothing less from you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这才是我想看到的，老师。

lines.en: : Why do you know the answer to that?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么会知道那个答案？！

lines.en: : Hey, I might not be the best at showing it...or applying it...but I’m actually pretty smart.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我也许不擅长表现出来……或者应用它……但我其实挺聪明的。

lines.en: : I’m offended you’d think otherwise, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你居然这么想，我很受伤，Ami。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I’ve never judged you at all. I think you’re brilliant and wonderful and the best man I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，我从来没有质疑过你。我觉得你聪明又出色，是我见过最好的男人。

lines.en: scene amimak14
a "Hey! You watch it! I’m supposed to be the primary love interest
lines.zh: a 「嘿！你给我注意点！我才是第一女主角，

lines.en: and I’m not gonna let some smartypants glasses-wearer get in the way of that!"
lines.zh: 我可不会让某个戴眼镜的书呆子挡我的道！」

lines.en: scene amimak10
: Who are you calling a smartypants glasses-wearer?!
lines.zh: : 你在说谁是戴眼镜的书呆子？！

lines.en: : The one who is a smartypants and is also wearing glasses!
lines.zh: : 那个又书呆子又戴眼镜的！

lines.en: "The two of them continue shouting at each other for another several minutes
lines.zh: 「她们两个又互相吼了好几分钟，

lines.en: before I finally decide to step in..."
lines.zh: 我终于决定出面……」

lines.en: x = by + m
lines.zh: x = by + m

lines.en: : Definitely ‘x = by + m.’
lines.zh: : 肯定是「x = by + m」。

lines.en: scene amimak12
: Tch-!
: Teehee~ Told you he doesn’t know!
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻~我就说他不知道！

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t interested in that kind of stuff!
lines.zh: : 老师对那种东西没兴趣！

lines.en: : That’s simply not true! Of course he’s interested in that kind of stuff. He just had...a momentary memory lapse.
lines.zh: : 那绝对不是真的！他当然对那种东西感兴趣。他只是……短暂地失忆了一下。

lines.en: : Things like that happen.
lines.zh: : 这种事常有。

lines.en: : Whatever you say, Makoto~
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说啦，Makoto~

lines.en: scene amimak15
: Listen, you two. It doesn’t matter whether or not I know this formula. What matters is that both of you do.
lines.zh: : 听着，你们两个。我知不知道这个公式并不重要。重要的是你们两个都得知道。

lines.en: : I’d hate to see something as simple as this hold either of you back.
lines.zh: : 我可不想看到你们因为这么简单的东西而被拖后腿。

lines.en: And I’d also hate to get in trouble for having some of my students fail the standardized test.
lines.zh: 而且我也不想因为有学生在标准考试里不及格而惹上麻烦。

lines.en: Thank god that Makoto is able to tutor everyone on things that I can’t remember or never learned in the first place.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，Makoto 能帮我给大家补习那些我记不起来、或者压根没学过的东西。

lines.en: : Well said, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 说得好，老师。

lines.en: : I mean, obviously you don’t have to worry about me. But those words are very wise when applied to everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我是说，显然我不用你操心。不过这话用在其他人身上非常明智。

lines.en: scene amimak16
: Can't you just study with me instead, Sensei? Makoto is a mean teacher.
lines.zh: : 你不能就跟我一起学吗，老师？Makoto 是个坏老师。

lines.en: scene amimak17
: I’m sorry, Ami...I just get frustrated whenever it seems like someone isn’t paying attention.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami……我只是看到有人好像没在听，就会着急。

lines.en: : So...you’re not gonna be a big meanie anymore?
lines.zh: : 那么……你以后不当大坏蛋了？

lines.en: : I...will do my best to not be a ‘big meanie...’
lines.zh: : 我……会尽量不当「大坏蛋」……

lines.en: : ...Fine. I guess I can try a little harder, too.
lines.zh: : ……好吧。我想我也可以再努力一点。

lines.en: : So, can we finally move on with things?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们终于可以继续了吗？

lines.en: : Can you do one more thing for me, first?
lines.zh: : 你能不能先再为我做一件事？

lines.en: : Of course. What do you need?
lines.zh: : 当然。你需要什么？

lines.en: : Can you admit that Sensei likes cute girls like me more than he likes nerdy ones like you?
lines.zh: : 你能不能承认，比起你这种书呆子，老师更喜欢我这种可爱的女生？

lines.en: scene amimak18
: Hey, don’t look at me. I can’t control her.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别看我。我管不了她。

lines.en: : She’s your [niece]. Can’t you at least tell her to focus?
lines.zh: : 她是你的[niece]。你至少能叫她专心点吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...I can try?
lines.zh: : 呃……我试试？

lines.en: : Ami, focus.
lines.zh: : Ami，专心。

lines.en: scene amimak19
: Yes, Sensei!~
lines.zh: : 是，老师！~

lines.en: scene amimak20
: Hah...how about we just take a break instead?
lines.zh: : 哈……不如我们干脆休息一下？

lines.en: mak "We’ve been at this for an hour and haven’t really gotten anywhere, so maybe
lines.zh: mak 「我们已经搞了一个小时，一点进展都没有，所以也许

lines.en: talking about something else for a little while might help?"
lines.zh: 聊点别的缓一缓会有帮助？」

lines.en: scene amimak21
: That works for me! I was getting tired of all the slopey stuff anyway.
lines.zh: : 我没意见！反正那些斜来斜去的东西我也腻了。

lines.en: : It’s slope int- ahh, forget it. Let’s just talk about something the two of us have in common instead.
lines.zh: : 是斜截——啊，算了。我们干脆聊聊我们两个的共同点吧。

lines.en: : Sure! Did you have anything in mind? The two of us have never really talked about stuff we have in common before.
lines.zh: : 好啊！你有想到什么吗？我们两个从来没聊过共同点呢。

lines.en: : That’s true. I don’t think I know much about you at all, Ami.
lines.zh: : 确实。我想我对你几乎一无所知，Ami。

lines.en: : How about you tell me your top three interests and I’ll see if any of mine match up?
lines.zh: : 不如你说说你最感兴趣的三个东西，我看看有没有跟我重合的？

lines.en: scene amimak22
: Hmm...my top three interests...Okay. So, in no particular order-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我最感兴趣的三个东西……好。那么，排名不分先后——

lines.en: : Cats, rabbits, and Sensei.
lines.zh: : 猫、兔子，还有老师。

lines.en: scene amimak23
: Your...[uncle] is in your top three interests?
lines.zh: : 你的……[uncle]排在你最感兴趣的三个东西里？

lines.en: : Of course. I love him and he loves me.
lines.zh: : 当然。我爱他，他也爱我。

lines.en: : Isn’t that a little...uhh...
lines.zh: : 这不是有点……呃……

lines.en: : Hm? A little what?
lines.zh: : 嗯？有点什么？

lines.en: : ...Nothing.
lines.zh: : ……没什么。

lines.en: : What are your top three, Makoto? Do we have any of the same stuff?
lines.zh: : 你的三个是什么，Makoto？我们有一样的吗？

lines.en: scene amimak24
: Uhhh...well it’s kind of embarrassing to say this in front of him, but...
lines.zh: : 呃……在他面前说这个有点难为情，不过……

lines.en: : I guess Sensei would be in my top three interests as well.
lines.zh: : 我想老师也会在我的前三名里。

lines.en: : Of course, it’s just because of how much of a role model he’s been for me in terms of teaching and...
lines.zh: : 当然，只是因为他在教学方面一直是我的榜样，而且……

lines.en: : Umm...yeah.
scene amimak21
: So...I guess we could talk about that if you want.
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你愿意的话，我们可以聊聊那个。

lines.en: scene amimak25
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : I’m keeping an eye on you, Makoto...
lines.zh: : 我盯着你呢，Makoto……

lines.en: : What? Did I...do something wrong?...
lines.zh: : 什么？我……做错什么了吗？……

lines.en: scene black
In the end, Ami never learned how slope intercept form works.
lines.zh: 到最后，Ami 也没搞懂斜截式到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: She wound up memorizing the formula, though, so hopefully she can just...figure it out come test-day.
lines.zh: 不过她把公式背下来了，所以希望她能在考试那天……自己推导出来。

lines.en: As for the relationship between these two-
lines.zh: 至于她们两个之间的关系——

lines.en: Well...I’m starting to think it’s just destined to not ever work out...
lines.zh: 嗯……我开始觉得，它大概注定永远好不了……
